source: make an open world game just like brookhaven 3d houses cars stores racing streets and other things that fit in a city the game must be highly detailed make it feel like your in a city in real life all must be detailed

answers.ask: Do players claim a pre-built house, or get an empty plot to build their own? That decision changes the whole city grid.
answers.answer: Players claim pre-built detailed 3D houses; the game is focused on a realistic city experience, not house construction.

answers.ask: Are the racing streets timed with laps and a finish line, or just roads that are good to drive fast on?
answers.answer: Use dedicated racing streets with timed laps and a clear finish line so players have an actual race activity.

scene_prompt: Create a detailed 3D open-world city map with a realistic, lived-in street grid. Arrange claimable pre-built detailed houses in residential neighborhoods, with stores and other city buildings along commercial streets. Include broad drivable roads for cars throughout the city and a dedicated racing-street circuit with a visible start/finish line and lap route. Compose dense urban foreground streets leading through housing and shop districts toward a larger city backdrop.
